summary: 0.2.4 fixes CEE electric train power interruptions at overhead-wire transitions and protects train readings from unrelated dimensions. API 1.0.0 and existing saves stay compatible.
changes: Preserve continuous train connections when crossing overhead-wire joints or adjacent contacts, avoiding false power drops.
Keep train readings, stored energy and traction updates in their owning dimension instead of letting another world overwrite them.
Avoid recursive API circuit loading during startup, and recover from unavailable train voltage while keeping genuine failed readings visible.
installation: Use Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge 21.1.231 or 21.1.248, Java 21, Create 6.0.10-280, CEE 1.1.3, Power Grid 0.6.2 and Architectury 13.0.8. Match server and client mod versions.
optional_installation: Pinout editions also require CC:Tweaked 1.120.2 and CC;CPG: Pinout 0.2.1.
